So the 50% Mn[5] sample released less heat, not more. The thermal tests report 901.4 J g^−1 for 10% Mn[6] and 485.7 J g^−1 for 50% Mn[7]. The 10% Mn[8] sample therefore released 415.7[9] J/g more heat than the 50% Mn[10] sample.
